map.title: Airport map
map.offline: The map is not updating. Showing the last view.
map.pick_hint: Tap the map to place yourself
map.off_route: You are away from the route. Head back to {place}.
map.arrived: You are at the end of the route.
map.no_route: Your route appears here once we know your flights.
voice.title: Voice
voice.press_hint: Tap to talk. You can also hold the button and let go when you are done.
voice.hint.start: Say your flights, for example DXB 402 then ZX 515.
voice.hint.asking: Say your answer, or tap one.
voice.hint.journey: Ask: where is my gate, or do I have time.
voice.noise.closer: Move closer to the screen and speak a little louder.
voice.unavailable.not_configured: Voice is not set up on this kiosk. Use touch or ask staff.
voice.unavailable.key_rejected: Voice is not available right now. Use touch or ask staff.
voice.unavailable.offline: Voice needs an internet connection. Use touch or ask staff.
voice.error.mic_denied: Microphone access is blocked. Allow it in the browser, or use touch.
voice.error.mic_missing: No microphone was found. Use touch or ask staff.
voice.error.busy: Voice is busy. Try again in a moment.
voice.error.generic: Voice stopped. Tap the microphone to try again.
voice.didnt_catch: I did not catch that. Try again a little closer, or tap an option.
voice.nothing_heard: I did not hear anything. Tap the microphone to try again.
voice.confirm.title: Is this right?
voice.reply.urgent: If this is an emergency, go to the nearest staffed help point now. Staff can help with every step.
voice.reply.assist: Opening the assistance request. Staff must approve it before anyone is sent.
kiosk.how.title: How this works
kiosk.how.1: Tell us your flights. Type them, say them, or pick from the board.
kiosk.how.2: We check your gate, your boarding cutoff and a route you can use, then keep watching.
kiosk.how.3: If you need physical help, ask here. A staff coordinator approves it before anyone is sent.
kiosk.how.note: Everything shown has a source and a time. When something is not known, it says so.
kiosk.start_note: After this, SkyAssist keeps watching and speaks up only if something changes.
kiosk.meaning.time_available: You have time. Walk to your gate at an easy pace.
kiosk.meaning.tight_connection: You can make it, but only if you start now.
kiosk.meaning.transfer_unlikely_before_c: Making this flight is unlikely. Ask staff for help now.
kiosk.meaning.may_miss_boarding: You may miss boarding. Move now and ask staff for help.
kiosk.meaning.boarding_cutoff_passed: Boarding has closed. Ask your airline about the next option.
kiosk.meaning.timing_unverified: We cannot confirm your timing yet. Check with staff before you move.
kiosk.assist.how_1: You send this request. Nothing is dispatched yet.
kiosk.assist.how_2: A staff coordinator reviews it and approves or declines.
kiosk.assist.how_3: If approved, staff come to your pickup point. Stay there until they arrive.
agent.intro.title: What SkyAssist does
agent.intro.empty: Your flights, gate and route show up here once you start.
